title: Shell Games: The Long-Term Performance of Chinese Reverse-Merger Firms

rival_explanations: the superior returns of CRMs are driven by the booming Chinese economy rather than firm quality
CRM outperformance reflects differences in probability of survival or distributional skewness (lottery-pick outliers) rather than fundamental quality

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (reverse-merger firms across 48 Fama-French industry classifications; no focal sector)
context.country_region: U.S. stock markets; reverse-merger firms by country of origin: China (146), U.S. (251), and other countries (27)

data_sources.name: 10-K filings (EDGAR) - hand-collected exchange/listing status, audit opinion, and PIPE financing details

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 424 RMs and 424 exchange-industry-date-size-matched control firms (CLs), Year T

dv.name: firm financial health and performance characteristics

controls.name: matched on date (of RM's first 10-K filing)

analyses.label: Table 2, Panel B & C: Summary Statistics for CRMs vs. U.S. RMs (Year T) and PIPE financing amounts
analyses.sample: Panel B: 146 CRMs and 251 U.S. RMs; Panel C: 80 CRMs and 178 U.S. RMs with non-missing PIPE financing

analyses.label: Table 3, Panels A & B: Distribution by Exchange and Survival Rates (Year T to T+3), RMs vs. CLs and CRMs vs. U.S. RMs
analyses.sample: Panel A: 424 RMs vs. 424 CLs; Panel B: 146 CRMs vs. 251 U.S. RMs

dv.name: listing exchange distribution / survival status
dv.measure: distribution across NMS, OTCBB, PINK (Pink Sheet), DEAD (deregistered/registration revoked), and ACQ (acquired) at Year T and each of the next three anniversary dates; Chi-square test of distribution equality

key_ivs.name: RM vs. CL / CRM vs. U.S. RM group
key_ivs.measure: RM indicator (1 for RMs, 0 for CLs); CN indicator (1 for CRMs, 0 for U.S. RMs)

analyses.label: Table 4, Panel A: Logistic regression of upward/downward exchange mobility, RMs vs. CLs (Equations 1 and 2)
analyses.sample: 424 RMs and 424 CLs, over three post-10-K time periods

analyses.label: Table 4, Panel B: Logistic regression of upward/downward exchange mobility, CRMs vs. U.S. RMs
analyses.sample: 146 CRMs and 251 U.S. RMs, over three post-10-K time periods

dv.name: UP / DOWN exchange mobility
dv.measure: UP and DOWN indicators as defined in Equations 1 and 2, measured over T to T+1, T+2, T+3

controls.name: life-cycle stage indicators (INTRODUCTION, GROWTH, MATURE, SHAKE-OUT)

analyses.label: Table 5, Panel A: Difference-in-differences univariate comparison of future performance (CRMs vs. U.S. RMs, adjusting for matched CLs)

dv.name: future operating performance and market liquidity

key_ivs.name: China Factor via DID
key_ivs.measure: difference-in-differences of RM-minus-CL paired differences between CRMs and U.S. RMs, eliminating effects of size, exchange, industry, and time

controls.name: size, exchange, industry, time (removed via matching/DID)

analyses.label: Table 5, Panel B: Difference-in-differences multivariate regression of future performance (Equation 3, RM x CN interaction)

dv.name: future performance metric (VAR): ROA, CFO, AUQ, SPREAD
dv.measure: VAR(t+i) = each performance metric (ROA, CFO, AUQ, or SPREAD) in years T+1, T+2, T+3

key_ivs.name: RM x CN interaction (b3, the DID estimator)

analyses.label: Table 6, Panels A & B: Future stock returns comparison, CRMs vs. U.S. RMs (raw and country-index-adjusted)
analyses.sample: 146 CRMs and 251 U.S. RMs surviving over the relevant return windows

dv.name: annual buy-hold stock returns
dv.measure: annual buy-hold raw returns computed from DataStream monthly returns (data type = RI), adjusted for delisting (set to -100 percent) and acquisition; Panel B subtracts the market index return of the country of domicile (China A-share index for CRMs, S&P 500 for U.S. RMs); returns over 12 months starting four months after each anniversary date, plus three-year cumulative

controls.name: country market index return (Panel B only: China A-share / S&P 500)

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: matched CRM-CL and U.S. RM-CL pairs, three post-10-K years

dv.name: future stock returns (DID)
dv.measure: paired difference in future stock returns between RMs and matched CLs (RM-CL), and DID between CRM-CL (a) and US-CL (b), eliminating effects of size, exchange, time, and industry

key_ivs.name: China Factor via DID
key_ivs.measure: difference-in-differences of RM-minus-CL return differences between CRMs and U.S. RMs

controls.name: size, exchange, time, industry (removed via matching/DID)

analyses.label: Table 7, Panel A: Predicting future outcomes of CRMs from Year-T characteristics
analyses.sample: CRMs (logit for UP/DOWN via Wald chi-square; OLS/t-tests for RETCLA and RETMKA)

dv.name: future prospects: UP, DOWN, RETCLA, RETMKA

key_ivs.name: PIPE financing and Year-T firm characteristics

analyses.label: Table 7, Panel B: Predicting future outcomes of U.S. RMs from Year-T characteristics
analyses.sample: U.S. RMs (logit for UP/DOWN; OLS for RETCLA and RETMKA)

dv.name: future prospects: UP, DOWN, RETCLA, RETMKA
dv.measure: UP / DOWN exchange mobility indicators; RETCLA = control-adjusted three-year cumulative return; RETMKA = country-market-index-adjusted three-year cumulative return

key_ivs.name: PIPE financing and Year-T firm characteristics
key_ivs.measure: PIPE indicator; ROA; AUQ; LEV; SIZE
